org.apache.juneau.commons.secret
A small, JDK-only SPI for storing and retrieving secrets by key — the secure, mutable sibling of PropertySource.
org.apache.juneau.secret.macos.keychain
An opt-in SecretStore backed by the macOS security keychain CLI.
